svg.text: a thread is a line (≈ git branch); a record is a station (≈ commit)
fork from any record, merge back
threads/<id> name, color, status, parent, forkOf, mergedInto, key
commits/<id> thread, kind, title, body, links, agent, ts, parents
edges/<id> from, to, label: a link drawn on the canvas
all three live in one file, data.json
Zero dependencies · local-first · the server listens on 127.0.0.1 only
